column1: # af3lis smoke test -- 2 baits x 6 preys = 12 folds, WITH CONTROLS.
# Not only a plumbing test. Three of the twelve pairs are interactions with
# solved structures and nine have no established interaction, so a run that
# completes but gets the biology backwards -- chains swapped, wrong chain pair
# scored, PAE transposed -- is caught instead of passing silently.
# `af3lis.sh check` asserts the positives outscore the negatives.
# Sequences come from examples/smoke.fasta, so the test is deterministic and
# runs offline. P61956 (SUMO2) is deliberately given as a BARE ACCESSION so the
# UniProt fetch path and seq_cache are still exercised on every run.
# Sizes: pair totals 157-592 tokens, spanning three token buckets (256/512/768);
# longest chain 440 aa, so the MSAs are quick.

column3: # SUMO2 -- bare accession on purpose: exercises UniProt fetch
